Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

speak up phrase

also louder, well, speak up!, speak, I’m listening, go ahead, I’m listening, out with it!, what is it? out with it!

classical

Traupman 33–34

Ēloquere.

Other words

  • Cedo! — out with it! tell me! give it here!

    old imperative (plural cette), with or without an object · also used · classical · Plaut. Most. 1.3.150: cedo aquam manibus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 111: quid est? cedo!

    (vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Plaut., Ter.)

    From -ce and the root of dō: “here with it!”, of a thing or of words. Short e, unlike cēdō, go.

Examples

  • Quīn tū ēloquere.

    Well, speak up!Traupman 108

  • Loquere, audiō.

    Speak, I’m listening.Traupman 108

  • Loquere! audiō.

    Speak! I’m listening.Traupman 383

  • Quīn tū ēloquere!

    Well, speak up!Traupman 383

See also lower your voice.
